title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Gravitation — 2022
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: State the concept of escape velocity. Calculate the escape velocity from the surface of a planet whose surface gravity is 5 m/s2 and radius is $6 \times 10^6$ m.
questions.solution:
**Escape velocity:** The escape velocity of a planet is the minimum velocity with which a body must be projected from the surface so that it **escapes the gravitational field** of the planet and never returns.

**Derivation:** If a body of mass $m$ is projected with velocity $v_e$, the total energy at the surface is
$$\frac{1}{2}mv_e^2 - \frac{GMm}{R}$$
For the body to just escape, this energy must be **zero** at infinity:
$$\frac{1}{2}mv_e^2 = \frac{GMm}{R} \Rightarrow v_e = \sqrt{\frac{2GM}{R}}$$
Since $g = \dfrac{GM}{R^2}$, we have $GM = gR^2$, hence
$$\boxed{v_e = \sqrt{2gR}}$$

**Numerical:**
$$v_e = \sqrt{2 \times 5 \times 6 \times 10^6} = \sqrt{6 \times 10^7}$$
$$\boxed{v_e \approx 7.75 \times 10^3\ \text{m/s}}$$

(Also $v_e = \sqrt{2}\,v_{orb}$.)
questions.knowledgeNote: Escape velocity is the root of 2gR, the minimum speed needed for a body to leave a planet's gravitational field.
